section_heading: Data Movement and Conversion Instructions: mov
exact_quote:
mov.f64 requires sm_13 or higher.
Taking the address of kernel entry functions requires sm_35 or higher.
reason_for_inclusion: Target ISA notes: mov.f64 requires sm_13+; kernel addresses require sm_35+; no family-specific target restriction is stated for the scalar mov.b32 value-copy form in this section.
